run_collage_from_prompt: run the collage creator with a text prompt and config file to generate a CLIP-optimized image
run_compositional_collage: run the collage creator with a 3x3 grid of regional prompts for compositional image generation
run_tiled_collage: run the collage creator with multiple tile prompts separated by pipes and slashes for a tiled image
run_collage_with_background: run the collage creator with a custom background image URL or solid RGB color
run_collage_with_evolution: run the collage creator with evolutionary mutation strategies like Microbial GA for population-based optimization
